si4_title.answer: Analyzing heterogeneity in Alzheimer disease using multimodal normative modeling on imaging-based ATN biomarkers

dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: ADNI (Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative) was used as the discovery dataset. The Charles F. and Joanne Knight Alzheimer's Disease Research Center (ADRC) dataset was used as the replication dataset.
dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: We constructed a discovery dataset consisting of individuals from ADNI and a replication dataset consisting of individuals from the Charles F. and Joanne Knight ADRC dataset...

answer.ADNI: normative training (ADNI-CU-train), validation (ADNI-CU-holdout), and test (ADNI-CU-test) for the discovery model; ADNI-ADS for clinical research (target disease group).

answer.Knight ADRC-ADS: normative training/transfer learning (ADRC-CU-tl), validation (ADRC-CU-holdout), and test (ADRC-CU-test) for the replication model; ADRC-ADS for clinical research (replication disease group).

dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Healthy controls (CU) from both datasets were split into training, validation, and test sets. The AD spectrum (ADS) groups were used to evaluate individual-level deviations, intra-group heterogeneity, and disease severity index.
dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: A total of 434 amyloid-negative CU participants were included in the reference control group (ADNI-CU)... 231 amyloid-positive individuals across the ADS were included in the target disease group (ADNI-ADS)... The ADRC-CU group (n=301) was also divided into a training set for transfer learning (n=225)...

dc3_healthy_control_number_of_each_norma.detail: For the ADNI cohort, 434 CU subjects were used overall, with 326 in the training set. For the ADRC cohort, 301 CU subjects were used overall, with 225 used for transfer learning (fine-tuning).
dc3_healthy_control_number_of_each_norma.supporting_text: A total of 434 amyloid-negative CU participants were included in the reference control group (ADNI-CU)... ADNI-CU-train; n = 326... ADRC-CU group consisted of 301 amyloid-negative CU individuals... ADRC-CU-tl; n = 225...

dc4_age_info_of_each_normative_model.detail: Age mean and SD for overall healthy control groups were obtained from Table S1. For the ADNI training set, the age range (47-91) was inferred from the one-hot encoding vector dimension described in the supplementary methods.
dc4_age_info_of_each_normative_model.supporting_text: ADNI-CU Age (mean +/- SD) 71.5 +/- 7.2; ADRC-CU Age (mean +/- SD) 68.2 +/- 7.3... each subject had an age vector with 44 positions, where each position corresponds to a year within the range of 47–91 years.
dc4_age_info_of_each_normative_model.location: media-3.docx.md: Table S1; SM4.3 Training details

dc5_sex_info_of_each_normative_model.detail: Sex distribution for the overall healthy control groups was obtained from Table S1. Female percentage for ADNI-CU: 229/434 = 52.8%; for ADRC-CU: 174/301 = 57.8%.
dc5_sex_info_of_each_normative_model.supporting_text: ADNI-CU Sex, Male: Female 205:229; ADRC-CU Sex, Male: Female 127:174.
